name: io.github.kacpergumieniuk/canisell
description: Pay-per-call (x402) SAFE/CAUTION/DANGER risk verdict for new ERC-20 tokens on Base.

environmentVariables.name: VERDICT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Canisell API.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x private key of a dedicated, low-balance wallet holding USDC on Base. Pays $0.01 per check via x402. Without it the tool returns the payment terms instead of a verdict.
